result.stdout:
budiff - ls for diffs

Usage:
  budiff [options] [file]
  budiff mcp

Options:
  -i              Open the desktop GUI for the same target
  -r, --gitroot   Widen scope to the repository root
  --base <ref>    Base ref for comparisons (default: HEAD)
  --head <ref>    Head ref; omit to compare against the working tree
  --days <n>      Bird's-eye analysis window in days (default 30; 0 = all time)
  --stdin         Read a unified diff from stdin and render it side-by-side
  --json          Write structured JSON instead of ANSI text
  --context <n>   With --json <file>: fold unchanged runs into Gap rows, keep n context lines
  -h, --help      Show help
  --version       Show the version

MCP:
  budiff mcp      Run a stdio MCP server for AI coding agents
